hstr_config.description: Comma-separated list of HSTR_CONFIG options controlling UI and behavior. Options include: hicolor, monochromatic, prompt-bottom, help-on-opposite-side, hide-basic-help, hide-help, no-confirm, regexp-matching, substring-matching, keywords-matching, case-sensitive, raw-history-view, favorites-view, static-favorites, skip-favorites-comments, duplicates, verbose-kill, blacklist, keep-page, big-keys-skip, big-keys-floor, big-keys-exit, warning, debug.

hstr_prompt.description: The string displayed as the prompt in the hstr suggestion box. Defaults to user@host$ in application, but often customized for brevity.

hstr_blacklist.description: List of command strings or patterns to blacklist. These commands will not be suggested by hstr. Written to ~/.hstr_blacklist. Items must be flat strings (e.g., 'sudo rm -rf', 'clear'). If empty, the built-in blacklist is used if the 'blacklist' option is not in HSTR_CONFIG, or no filtering occurs otherwise.
